title: The Coso Artifact
hook: What 1920s-era Champion spark plug was found buried?
headline: Mystery Metal from Deep Time

beats.label: THE CASE
beats.line: On Feb 13, 1961, Wallace Lane, Virginia Maxey and Mike Mikesell discovered the artifact while prospecting near Olancha, California.

beats.label: CLUE 1
beats.line: The core layer was thought to be five hundred thousand years old, but geologists say its formation likely took place over decades or years.

beats.label: CLUE 2
beats.line: Scientists said the shape matched a 1920s spark plug, impossible for that ancient layer.

beats.label: THE TWIST
beats.line: In 1978, tests hinted contamination, yet no evidence confirmed the artifact as a hoax.

end.line: Could a modern object truly predate humanity?

description: Explore the puzzling Coso Artifact found in a 500,000-year-old core.
